death.place: Plymouth Township, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, USA

summary: Irish-born wife of the Plymouth miner Martin Murphy and mother of seven, buried at St. Vincent de Paul Cemetery, Larksville; John's 3rd-great-grandmother.
bio:
Alice Comerford was born in Ireland about 1835 and married Martin Murphy, a miner of Plymouth, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania. In 1870 she was keeping house in Plymouth Township with seven children at home, among them the one-month-old twins Martin and Thomas. She died in Plymouth Township on 18 February 1876, when the twins were about six, and was buried at St. Vincent de Paul Cemetery in Larksville.

Comerford is a surname characteristic of north Kilkenny and the Slieveardagh border, the same district as the Heffernans, though this is only a hint from surname geography. A John Comerford household from Ireland lived next to the Pringles in Plymouth in 1880. She is probably John's 3rd-great-grandmother.
